description: Defines inline functions to build various error indication messages used in the ocudu::fapi namespace, based on specific error codes and message types.

methods.name: build_error_indication
methods.description: Constructs an error_indication message with specified slot, message ID, and error code.

methods.name: build_out_of_sync_error_indication
methods.description: Constructs an error_indication message indicating an out-of-sync error, including expected slot.

methods.name: build_invalid_sfn_error_indication
methods.description: Constructs an error_indication message indicating an invalid SFN error, including expected slot.

methods.name: build_msg_error_indication
methods.description: Constructs an error_indication message for a message slot error.

methods.name: build_msg_tx_error_indication
methods.description: Constructs an error_indication message for a transmission error.

methods.name: build_msg_ul_dci_error_indication
methods.description: Constructs an error_indication message for an UL DCI error.
